manifest.name: @ai-sdk/anthropic
manifest.description: The **[Anthropic provider](https://ai-sdk.dev/providers/ai-sdk-providers/anthropic)** for the [AI SDK](https://ai-sdk.dev/docs) contains language model support for the [Anthropic Messages API](https://docs.anthropic.com/claude/reference/messages_post).

manifest.name: pixi.js

scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:docs && copyfiles -u 1 "dist/**/*" .s3_uploads/
scripts.start: npm run dev --prefix playground & npm run watch:lib
scripts.watch:lib: nodemon --watch "./src/*" --exec "npm run build:status start && node ./scripts/build.mts --lib --dev && npm run build:status done" -e ts,js,vert,frag,wgsl,d.ts --ignore "index.ts"
scripts.build:docs: npx typedoc --options .configs/typedoc.json && node ./scripts/typedoc/html-to-md.mts && copyfiles -f dist/pixi.min.mjs dist/pixi.min.mjs.map .s3_uploads/docs/
